Name: Dodge-Weave
Casting Time: 1 reaction, taken when you are hit by an attack
Description:
You briefly vanish, gaining a +5 bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

If your attacker is within 30 feet of you, you may teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of them.

On your next turn, you have advantage on your first attack roll against that attacker.
At Higher Levels: When cast using a 4th-level spell slot or higher, the distance from which you can teleport toward the attacker increases by 10 feet for each slot level above 3rd.
